annotations.title: Agent Run: run a Python or Node.js program in a fresh isolated container and get stdout and output files, now or in the background

description: Use when an agent must compute, parse a CSV or draw a chart with real code. Input: language (python|node), code (64 KB), stdin, files (5 /v1/files ids), background. Output: exitCode, stdout, stderr, /workspace/out files (5, 2 MB, base64). 30 s in the response ($0.005), or background=true: 10 min, id + secret now, result at GET /v1/agent/run/{id} ($0.008). HTTP(S) allowed. Python: pandas, numpy, matplotlib; Node: lodash. Example: POST {"code":"print(2+2)"} Price: $0.005–$0.01 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.

background.description: true: run up to 10 minutes in the background ($0.008); the answer is an id and a one-time secret, and GET /v1/agent/run/{id} with header x-run-secret returns the result (?wait=1-25 long-polls). Default false: up to 30 s, result in the response ($0.005)

code.description: Program source, max 64 KB; runs as /workspace/main.py or main.js; write result files to /workspace/out

credit_budget.description: With Authorization: Bearer <credit session>: USD cap (0.001-20, default 0.10) for 1gateway API calls the program makes; each call is charged its credit price

files.description: Up to 5 ids of your own /v1/files uploads (same paying wallet), copied to /workspace/in/<filename>; 10 MB total

notify_email.description: Background only (+$0.002): email when the run ends, to an address that already allowed mail from your wallet (/v1/agent/email/send consent)

stdin.description: Text fed to the program's standard input, max 256 KB

webhook.description: Background only: signed POST (x-1gateway-signature, key = hex(SHA-256(secret))) when the run ends
